# Brandon Micci - Enterprise AI & Digital Transformation Executive

> Senior AI executive with 17+ years delivering Fortune 500 transformations. $50M+ in documented savings, 27K+ AI users enabled, 250% peak program ROI. Expert in AI strategy, LLM deployment, and data platform architecture.

## Professional Summary

I am an AI & Digital Transformation Executive who turns emerging technology into measurable enterprise growth. Over the past 17 years, I've led large-scale transformations that delivered $50M+ in documented savings, scaled GenAI to 27,000+ users, accelerated cloud adoption by 200%, and built platforms that reshape how Fortune 500 organizations operate.

At JPMorgan Chase, I led AI strategy across the Payments business — merchant services, client servicing, client onboarding, and global call centers — building scalable, modern, AI-ready platforms that modernize financial services and enhance client experience. My leadership has also included deploying an enterprise LLM-powered AI Assistant scaled to 27,000+ users in a Fortune 500 payments organization, architecting IoT solutions that save $20M+ annually, and helping win a $400MM, 10-year engagement at EY to design and build an AI-powered fraud detection engine for a Fortune 50 insurance client.

I specialize in building and leading high-performing organizations that connect cutting-edge AI and emerging technologies to real business challenges. My expertise includes:
• Enterprise AI/ML strategy and execution at scale
• Digital transformation across Fortune 500 organizations
• Cloud modernization and DevOps acceleration (200% faster cloud adoption)
• Building and leading data science & analytics teams (50+ FTEs)
• Go-to-market strategy for emerging technologies

Philosophy: Technology should make organizations smarter, faster, and more resilient. I thrive at the intersection of AI innovation and business strategy, translating complex technical concepts into executive-level impact and leading teams that deliver measurable business value.

## Most Recent Role

### Head of AI Strategy & Business Transformation - JPMorgan Chase
**February 2024 - March 2026 | Plano, Texas**

Drove enterprise AI strategy and implementation across JPMorgan Chase Payments, leading organization-wide transformation initiatives that enhanced operational efficiency and customer experience. Oversaw AI product development lifecycle from strategy through deployment and scaling.

**Key Achievements:**
- Owned end-to-end AI portfolio for the entire JPMorgan Chase Payments business — strategy through delivery — including merchant services, client servicing, client onboarding, and global call centers
- Architected reusable AI platform with shared building blocks (APIs, services, prompt/agent patterns, playbooks, evaluation harnesses) for production-grade reliability and observability
- Architected comprehensive AI strategy driving operational efficiency and workforce optimization across the Payments business
- Scaled an enterprise AI Assistant (LLM) to 27,000+ users across the Payments organization
- Designed human-in-the-loop (HITL) review workflows for high-stakes AI-assisted decisions in regulated payments environments
- Established LLM evaluation harnesses and AIOps (LLMOps) practice ensuring continuous improvement across the AI delivery lifecycle (experiment → production → operations)
- Deployed intelligent automation that reduced average handle time by up to ~40% in targeted servicing workflows
- Established Responsible AI by design — embedded governance, model risk frameworks, and audit/compliance partnership across multiple business units

## Career History

### Senior Director, Head of AI/IoT & Emerging Technology Practice - Capgemini
**January 2022 - June 2022 (6 months) | Dallas, Texas**

Headed the AI/IoT and Emerging Technology Practice, directing go-to-market strategy and solution development for emerging AI technologies. Led cross-functional teams of product managers, solution architects, and sales professionals across market penetration and revenue growth in intelligent industry solutions.

**Key Achievements:**
- Orchestrated go-to-market strategy for NextGen insurance solutions, generating $9.8M in qualified pipeline
- Architected telematics solutions for Fortune 50 insurance providers, delivering significant improvement in loss mitigation through real-time predictive analytics
- Launched Industry 4.0 IoT Platform integrating telematics, smart building monitoring, wearables, and industrial equipment under a unified ecosystem with real-time AI analytics and detection
- Established innovation practice from the ground up, creating new service offerings and commercializing Industry 4.0, NextGen and AI solutions that expanded market reach across the insurance sector

### Senior Manager, AI/ML Forensic Analytics & Technology - Ernst & Young (EY)
**February 2021 - January 2022 (1 year) | Dallas, Texas**

Spearheaded AI/ML strategy and capability development within Ernst & Young's Forensics Practice, serving as Regional Leader and subject matter expert for complex analytics engagements across Financial Services, Life Sciences, and Energy sectors.

**Key Achievements:**
- Helped win a $400MM, 10-year strategic engagement with a global insurance leader, delivering real-time AI-powered fraud analytics engine that enhanced threat detection and response capabilities
- Developed Analytics-as-a-Service platform automating Risk, Compliance, and Fraud detection processes, generating $25MM+ in annual recurring revenue
- Led talent development initiatives scaling AI/ML capabilities regionally and establishing forensic analytics COE

### Head of Digital Innovation & IoT - Southwest Airlines
**August 2019 - December 2020 (1 year 5 months) | Dallas, Texas**

Promoted to newly created role after identifying advanced operational data needs. Led strategic digital transformation using IoT, AI, and Edge Computing platforms. Reported directly to CIO with $25M annual technology budget.

**Key Achievements:**
- Pioneered breakthrough IoT Fuel Savings pilot delivering 250% ROI within six months, leading to rapid scaling that deployed capabilities to 3 airports monthly and generated $20M annual savings
- Led comprehensive innovation transformation implementing IoT capabilities across 3 Fuel Farms, 7 Baggage Handling Systems, and 8 De-Icing Stations while architecting AWS-based platform for enhanced resiliency and reliability
- Migrated 10+ legacy applications to the cloud in 6 months, reducing annual technology spend by $3.2M

### Manager, Data Enablement & Analytics COE - Southwest Airlines
**February 2019 - August 2019 (7 months) | Dallas, Texas**

Recruited to replicate the Capital One enterprise analytics community-of-practice model. Built comprehensive data community and center of excellence across enterprise analytics platforms.

**Key Achievements:**
- Decommissioned 1,000+ underutilized legacy dashboards across 5 BI platforms (Business Objects, Quickbase, Cognos, Crystal Reports)
- Built a Data Analyst Community scaling to 2500+ users with 40% adoption increase of Tableau & Alteryx
- Architected Tier 1 Production Data Environment meeting Tier-1 availability and disaster-recovery targets for critical real-time Ops Data

### Vice President, Global Infrastructure Transformation - Citigroup
**November 2017 - February 2019 (1 year 4 months) | Irving, Texas**

Led global infrastructure transformation initiatives, driving quality improvement and performance optimization across Citigroup's worldwide technology ecosystem. Responsible for strategic technology modernization and cloud enablement programs.

**Key Achievements:**
- Architected global telemetry platform that eliminated recurring Sev1 outages across worldwide operations
- Championed DevOps transformation program accelerating cloud enablement by 200% through CI/CD pipeline implementation and a microservices architecture
- Drove modernization initiatives across legacy infrastructure stacks, establishing enterprise-standard performance standards

### Enterprise Risk Analytics Leader - Capital One
**July 2016 - November 2017 (1 year 5 months) | Plano, Texas**

Built and led the first Risk & Analytics Reporting Team for Capital One's Auto Finance & Home Loans division. Architected comprehensive data warehouse and analytics platform within 2 months.

**Key Achievements:**
- Built and led team of 10 data engineers and analysts, architecting the first dedicated Tableau environment for Auto Finance
- Implemented automated compliance testing with advanced NLP solutions to digest customer complaints and real-time OCR scanning for regulatory requirements, creating automated controls to detect emerging high-risk blind spots

### Enterprise Analytics Leader, Compliance - Capital One
**January 2016 - July 2016 (7 months) | Richmond, Virginia**

Led development of large-scale Tableau Dashboard efforts cross-functionally as internal consultant. Managed team of 10 on-shore Data Engineers and Data Analysts across enterprise risk and compliance initiatives.

**Key Achievements:**
- Led a team of 10 data engineers and analysts delivering 15+ enterprise risk dashboards across risk and compliance functions
- Established the enterprise gold standard for data quality — governance frameworks, automated lineage, and validation processes

### Big Data, Analytics, and Platforms COE Leader - Capital One
